description: The admin login on the footer and the editing mode it turns on for a signed-in admin only: every content photo outlined with its chip (native size · displayed size · the limit), a click opens a picker, a valid file goes to the site-images bucket and a site_image_slots row; every content text is a slot edited in place into site_content_slots; every save versioned and audited by the database as a publish content act at the login class.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Editing on or off; on is possible only for a session whose email is in site_admin

capabilities: auth:session (Supabase Auth on sturij-web — an email link or code)
revalidate (/api/revalidate — the page re-reads its slots)

delta: a login gate (Supabase Auth, the site_admin list) in place of a free toggle
the bucket and the versioned slot tables in place of localStorage
the refusals: type, size, minimum width — with the reason
the audit row written by the database on every save
